correctness.rationale: Edge-by-edge summation and counting unary assignments prove the exact binomial-quadratic pmf on both stated parameter boundaries. The Lambert saddle solves log(n/x)=2ax. Uniform Stirling expansion gives the local exponent -a(j-theta)^2 and 1/sqrt(2pi x) prefactor. Exact monotone adjacent ratios bound both integer tails by summable exp(-a j^2+O(j)); dominated summation yields a relative-error partition asymptotic and total-variation approximation, not merely finite computation. The saddle increment tends to zero and its phases are dense. The q_theta(1)/q_theta(0) ratio distinguishes subsequences. Finite enumeration n<=3 and independent numerical tests n<=100000 PASS, but infinite proof is the symbolic argument.
